description_en: Changes the specifications of a virtual bridge
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-virtual-bridge-level --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bridge-id vb-sfjoasjfosdfj00 --bridge-level vb.pro --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVirtualBridgeLevel

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The renewal duration. Valid values of this parameter are determined by the value of the `PeriodUnit` parameter.

If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 6.
If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values are 1, 2, and 3.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长。取值范围由参数`PeriodUnit`的值决定。

`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围为：1、2、3、6。
`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围为：1、2、3。

默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration for the prepaid cloud disk. This parameter takes effect and is required only when the `CdsChargeType` parameter is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 预付费网盘的购买时长单位。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect and is optional only when the billing method is `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动续费。仅当付费类型为`PrePaid`时，该参数才生效且为可选参数
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The promotion ID. You can call the pricing query operation to obtain the list of matched promotion IDs
parameters.help_zh: 优惠活动ID，可以通过询价接口获取命中的活动ID列表
parameters.name: promotion_id
